doc.class_javadoc: /** * {@link JsonGenerator} that outputs JAXB-style XML output instead of JSON content. * Operation requires calling code (usually either standard Jackson serializers, * or in some cases (like BeanSerializer) customised ones) to do * additional configuration calls beyond regular {@link JsonGenerator} API, * mostly to pass namespace information. */ public final

siblings.javadoc:
/**
     * Method called before writing any other output, to optionally
     * output XML declaration.
     */
siblings.name: initGenerator

siblings.javadoc: /** * Stax2 does not expose buffered content amount, so we can only return * -1 from here */
siblings.name: getOutputBuffered

siblings.javadoc:
/** * Method that allows application direct access to underlying * Stax {@link XMLStreamWriter}. Note that use of writer is * discouraged, and may interfere with processing of this writer; * however, occasionally it may be necessary. *

* Note: writer instance will always be of type * {@link org.codehaus.stax2.XMLStreamWriter2} (including * Typed Access API) so upcasts are safe. */
siblings.name: getStaxWriter

siblings.javadoc:
/**
     * Method that does same as {@link #setNextName}, unless
     * a name has already been set.
     * 
     * @since 2.1.2
     */
siblings.name: setNextNameIfMissing

siblings.javadoc:
/**
     * Methdod called when a structured (collection, array, map) is being
     * output.
     * 
     * @param wrapperName Element used as wrapper around elements, if any (null if none)
     * @param wrappedName Element used around individual content items (can not
     *   be null)
     */
siblings.name: startWrappedValue
finishWrappedValue

siblings.javadoc:
/**
     * Trivial helper method called when to add a replicated wrapper name
     * 
     * @since 2.2
     */
siblings.name: writeRepeatedFieldName
writeFieldName

siblings.javadoc:
/**
     * Method called to see if unwrapping is required; and if so,
     * clear the flag (so further calls will return 'false' unless
     * state is re-set)
     */
siblings.name: checkNextIsUnwrapped
_reportUnimplementedStax2
